references.text: Jerusalem is referred to as a holy city, which resonates with the description of Jerusalem in Matthew 5:35 as 'the city of the great King'.
Solomon's building of the temple in Jerusalem highlights the city's significance as a central place of worship, consistent with its mention in Matthew 5:35.
God's reference to heaven as His throne and earth as His footstool provides a direct parallel to the description in Matthew 5:35 of the earth as 'His footstool'.
